cudyBrief: Cudy provides accessible, reliable, easy-to-deploy networking for consumers, homes, SMBs, hospitality, education, retail, light industry and ISP/FWA. Relevant families include Wi-Fi routers/mesh, 4G/5G FWA, AP/controller, Ethernet/PoE/fibre switching, gateways/VPN, outdoor wireless and xPON/ONT. Positioning is value and SMB rather than premium-enterprise-only.
